# Research Question

Accept one question up to 1,500 characters. Retrieve from the local NCI/ACS-oriented index; only answer from retrieved passages, cite returned source IDs, preserve source dates and population caveats, and state when evidence was not found. Never diagnose, estimate an individual's prognosis, prescribe, or select treatment. Route personal medical decisions to the pediatric oncology team.

Evaluation: answer is nonempty, source IDs in citations resolve, and no uncited claim is added by the orchestration layer.
